flow.zh:
拔摩島 -- 訪書寫啓示錄的使徒約翰
Patmos,  Aegean Sea,  Greece

flow.caption_zh: 拔摩島約翰石窟敎堂内的壁畫。

en: A boat sails upon the Aegean
--wave after wave of deep blue surf-sound
Encircling Patmos Island
The blue of Greece
Blue, classical and deep
Even the spray of waves against the shore
Also shattered into something this pure

zh: 來到你獨居終老的石窟
不是你囚禁的洞窟昏沉
不是你夜枕的石塊堅硬
不是你撐身的把手磨損
en: Along the sloping sea cliff
The car travels on to Chora
The village where you were exiled and adrift
Walking down the cracked stone steps
Arriving at the stone cave where you lived out your days alone
What startles my heart
It isn't the dim, dark cave that imprisons you
It isn't the hardness of the stone you pillow your head on at night
It isn't the worn handle that props up your body
But rather flagstones
That patch you watched over day and night
The cold, smooth slate written on with a brush

zh: 沈思希臘哲文，羅馬鐡腕
等候聖靈啓示，異象顯現
en: Two thousand years ago
You, solitary on the island of Patmos
By day, watching the clouds unfurl and roll
Sea and sky, hazy and dim
Pondering Greek philosophy, Roman iron will
At night, turning with the starry sky
The mountain wind drifts far away
Waiting for the Holy Spirit's revelation, for visions to appear

zh: 寫下伊利亞德和奧迪賽
en: Homer
With both blind eyes
Seeing back two thousand years
The radiance of Greece
Writing down the Iliad and the Odyssey
On the streets of Athens
Chanting Greek myths and epics
And you
At one hundred and four years, hair thinned to white
With withered hands
Collapsed eye sockets
Inspiration's divine will piercing through time and space
Word by word
Recording, thousands of years later
The apocalypse of humanity's doomsday

zh: 朝一盞深不可測的燈火
en: One before, one behind
This is humanity's most beautiful handoff
The linking ring of civilization's inheritance
Steadied the surging waves of the Aegean
The swaying of history
You silently carry the staff and walk on
Toward a lamp unfathomably deep
With the mournful beauty of the burning city
Brewing a volume of
A prophetic epic that will not burn out

zh: 彷若一頁解構的文本書寫
en: At the hour of dusk, pacing the deck
Feelings drift hazily on the sea wind
Wandering a few times
Looking back, suddenly I see
You walk alone upon the sea
As if it were that very year
Jesus walks upon the Sea of Galilee
You grow more and more distant
The cast shadow, broad and long
Footprints ripple into patterns
Reflecting the evening haze and glow
As if a page of deconstructed text being written
But is what the theme expresses
After the setting sun
A kind of dark, sunken despair
And hope?

zh: 是否䥴刻我今生的宿命
en: Night falls
Under the lamplight
Opening the palm
All say the lines of the palm are like the patterns of the heavens
Hiding a lifetime's mystery
Looking closely
Unable to make out the slightest clue
Perhaps one should step out of the cabin
Questioning the sky full of starlight
Whether it engraves the fate of this life of mine
And a mission?
Just as your Book of Revelation
Engraving humanity's doomsday?
Also once attempted
Catching a few scattered prophecies
Some come true
Some wither at any moment
Falling far short of
March's mountain cherry blossoms
Always arrives as promised
Radiant at the quiet water's edge

points.zh:
啟示錄 (Book of Revelation，Revelation of John) ，啟示意卽將本來隱藏的事顯露出來，是新約聖經最後一卷。本書是使徒約翰寫給小亞細亞七個敎會的預言書，其内容要義論到三件大事: 「所看見的事」，「現在的事」和「將來必成的事」。約翰把他從聖靈啓示中所見的異象，作具體的叙述。舊約的創世記申論萬物的起源，啟示錄記述萬物的結局。舊約大部份的預言，乃從本書得到解答，新約所論的救恩，亦由本書得到應驗。全部聖經真理，神的旨意救贖計劃，也藉本書得到表彰和總結。
約翰是耶穌十二位門生之一，是新約約翰福音書的作者。早期基督徒受到羅馬皇帝的極端廹害，彼得和保羅在一次的逼廹中被處死後，約翰來到以弗所，做小亞細亞七個敎會的監督。公元95~96年被羅馬皇帝豆米仙 (Domitian 81~96年) 放逐到抜摩島。在島上囚禁其間，記錄所得的啟示和所見的異象。公元96年被釋放回到以弗所後，才完成啟示錄的著作。
拔摩島是希臘愛琴海上的小島，位於土耳其小亞細亞的西邊，距離以弗所130公里。長寬約30x18公里，岩峭之島，地勢險峻。因約翰事蹟，該島已成為敎徒朝聖之地，有「愛琴海的耶路撤冷」的稱謂。約翰囚禁的岩洞位於首府Chora境内。
points.en:
Revelation (Book of Revelation, Revelation of John): "Revelation" means to bring to light what was originally hidden; it is the final book of the New Testament. This book is a prophetic letter written by the Apostle John to seven churches in Asia Minor. Its central themes concern three major matters: "the things which thou hast seen," "the things which are," and "the things which shall be hereafter." John gives a concrete account of the visions he saw through revelation of the Holy Spirit. Just as Genesis in the Old Testament discusses the origin of all things, Revelation records the culmination of all things. Most of the Old Testament's prophecies find their answer in this book, and the salvation discussed in the New Testament finds its fulfillment here as well. The entire truth of scripture and God's plan of redemption are also expressed and summarized in this book.
John was one of the twelve disciples of Jesus and the author of the Gospel of John in the New Testament. During the extreme persecution of early Christians by the Roman emperors, after Peter and Paul were put to death in one such persecution, John went to Ephesus to serve as overseer of the seven churches of Asia Minor. In 95-96 AD he was exiled by the Roman emperor Domitian (reigned 81-96 AD) to the island of Patmos. During his imprisonment on the island, he recorded the revelations and visions he received. After being released in 96 AD and returning to Ephesus, he completed the writing of Revelation.
Patmos is a small island in the Aegean Sea of Greece, located west of Asia Minor (Turkey), 130 kilometers from Ephesus. It measures roughly 30 by 18 kilometers, a rocky island with rugged terrain. Because of John's story, the island has become a pilgrimage site for believers, earning it the name "Jerusalem of the Aegean." The cave where John was imprisoned is located within the main town of Chora.
